title: Cannot find login fields inside an iframe (App Store Connect, etc.)
symptom: The login fields are visible, but web find cannot find them and web type · click --selector end with a timeout or assert_failed. Writing 'iframe >> input' does not match either
cause: The login form is inside an iframe (App Store Connect login, etc.). web find scans only the top-level document. --selector on type · click · text · assert is a Playwright selector, so it needs the step that enters the iframe (internal:control=enter-frame) to reach it
fix: launch_cli.py web type --selector "iframe >> internal:control=enter-frame >> input#account_name_text_field" --cred <name> --cred-field account
launch_cli.py web click --selector "iframe >> internal:control=enter-frame >> #sign-in" --expect-text <text shown after login>
With several iframes, narrow the first step to iframe#<id>. web find does not look inside iframes, so pick field names from a web shot
In a read-only (--readonly) session the login button may be blocked too — tell the user and add --confirm-mutating
